quest.title: The Other Side of the Sky
quest.description: Passing through an ocean of clouds, you finally arrive at the legendary Tonatiuh...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm: Act III
chapter.title: The Tonatiuh Quivers

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're... We're alive! Sure feels great to step on solid ground again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you float.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's a huge difference between hovering near the ground and being blown all over the place in the skies!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The "ground" here doesn't look too solid, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't scare Paimon like that! If we do fall, she can't pull both you and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} back up!

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Cheep, ku...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that the Tonatiuh? Woohoo, we've done it!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks more like a huge ball of yarn than a ship, though! Or snakes, what with all those tangled lines...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it looks safer, at least, so let's fly over there... Um, wait. Where did Bona go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She did say she has a lot of flying experience, but Paimon's still kinda worried.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As long as the wind direction was correct...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're right, she probably landed somewhere around here, if that's the case.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We won't know if we just stay here either way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're right, we have to get going. Maybe she's already waiting for us onboard the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? It looks like Pyrophosphorite, but it's all shiny and flam-ey and stuff. Sure looks more powerful than the one Bona has.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could this be Pyrophosphorite's original form?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ouch! It's burning hot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't just touch whatever you find, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't realize...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, the pot's calling the kettle black.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What is it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Do you know something about this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! It's finally your time to shine, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we'll let you handle any hot and sizzling treasures from now on!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Yee! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hey! Hey! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's Bona!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did she get there? Did she land... Anyway, let's go over there first!

talks.objective: Go with your little Tepetlisaurus to where Bona is

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #There you are, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there Bona! Paimon's glad to see you're okay!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Oh? Worried about me, Paimon? Don't worry! I'm the ace adventurer of the Flower-Feather Clan. It'll take a lot more to bring down someone like me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's good to see that you're well, either way.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe it's also thanks to you. My luck's been looking up ever since we met!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: After I got separated from you guys in the clouds, I was blown onto a floating rock and passed out. I'm not sure how much time went by, but when I woke up, I found myself here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you end up here?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, after I got separated from you guys in the clouds, I was blown onto a floating rock and passed out. I'm not sure how much time went by, but when I woke up, I found myself here.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: When I woke up, I searched everywhere, but had no luck finding you, so I thought you... Anyway, looks like you guys are tougher than you seem too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon was just about to ask how you got up here, actually. These are all isolated floating islands, so did you fly up here or something?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hehe, let's talk about that later. Anyway, this is the Tonatiuh we've been looking for. Our adventure's been a great success!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, but from the looks of this place, it doesn't seem to have treasures scattered everywhere like the legends say. Has someone else come and taken them all away?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: For my part, I'd bet on our so-called Tonatiuh treasures being made up by tribal storytellers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No way! So you're telling Paimon that we came here for nothing!?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: While the treasures might be fabricated, that doesn't mean the Jade of Return we're looking for isn't here. We can't give up hope yet.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Also, look up at that thing over there!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: See how there's something inside? You found a Pyrophosphorite inside the Core of Chu'ulel just now, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, based on my experience as an adventurer, it stands to reason that the Jade of Return we seek is in there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, let's figure out a way to get up there and smash it open!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hold on now, it's not as simple as you think! I've already tried. It's not something that can be smashed open with brute force.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something tells me things won't be that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Yeah, this doesn't look like something we can break open using only brute force.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: My adventuring experience suggests that there should be some sort of mechanism around here, just like when we got the Pyrophosphorite earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Speaking of mechanisms, this must be it right here! It looks exactly like the Altar of Primal Flame we saw earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: What a coincidence... Wait, this can't be a coincidence. This must be some sort of clue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If it's a clue, maybe we should try using the Pyrophosphorite to... Uh, hang on. We don't have any left, do we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s carrying one right now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, we stumbled upon this on our way here...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: This must be it! Are you familiar with the principle of the "Adventurer's Key"? It states that the crucial item needed at the final stage of an adventure is always acquired at its beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds like nonsense! Plus, this interval is kinda tight, don't you think? That said, this thing sure does look like Pyrophosphorite...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, apart from the constant crackling and spitting flames, Paimon thinks they're exactly the same!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Wow, you're right. I totally wouldn't have realized if it weren't for you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That, uh, sounds like a you problem, but anyway, based on what you said, we just need to collect stones like that, right?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, if we're looking for these Firestones, there are four in total on this ship. For example, there should be one on the floating island across from us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh... Wait, Bona, how do you know all this? It's almost like you've been here before. Really, it feels like there's more to this than "adventuring experience."

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Uh, how should I put it... I guess it's like an adventurer's premonition? I'm not sure why, but as soon as I saw this Altar, I knew how to use it.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I was also investigating this place before meeting you guys. Conducting a thorough preliminary investigation is a must for an ace adventurer, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see. Guess you learn something every day.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #Wait, so you've just been brute-forcing your way through this whole time, {NICKNAME}...? Must be nice being able to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Luckily, I always rely on brute force.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, you're just one of a kind, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, how are we even gonna get over there? Might be a little tricky, even for you.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Hehe... Also, aren't you curious about how I got up here earlier? Now's the time to show you my discovery.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, how about it? We can use this mechanism to freely travel between the floating islands.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you to find them. Just holler over to me if you cross over to another floating island and can't get back here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright, and we'll leave the job of holding the Firestones up to you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo, we did it! Hmm, still, this is a rather familiar Iridescent Inscription. Is this the famous Jade of Return, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second, isn't this the Golden Entreaty? It's the same as the one we got at the stone tablet back then!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooo... Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, that really is the case!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And y'know, a treasure that can suppress the filth of the Abyss and a token that can remove curses and disasters do sound somewhat similar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're only realizing this now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? Why didn't you just tell Paimon if you already knew!? Wait a second, how did you even know? Wait, is this an "adventurer's experience" thing again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Come to think of it, a treasure that can suppress the filth of the Abyss and a token that can remove curses and disasters do sound somewhat similar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But can this thing really suppress the Abyss in Ochkanatlan? Paimon's never heard anyone from the Saurian Relics Association mention it before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, and since the Jade of Return is just a Golden Entreaty, could that be why the evil dragon has been targeting us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, so it wasn't because it was eyeing the Blazed Meat Stew Paimon had this morning...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like the clues are falling into place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like it really was foreshadowing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, but Bona probably doesn't know about the Golden Entreaty yet... Hey, Bona?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Something's not right... I'm sure I've been here before, the Tonatiuh, and the Jade of Return...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Yes, we must destroy it... It cannot fall into the hands of that person...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you okay, Bona?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Bona? No... Bona should be long gone. Why am I still here...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #I see, so that's what's— Careful, {NICKNAME}! Don't come any closer. This is a trap...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we did it! So this is the super famous legendary Jade of Return, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Can this thing really suppress the filth of the Abyss in Ochkanatlan?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just going by shape, it looks more like a plate for food.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come on, enough about food already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of food, Paimon, your breakfast...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean the Blazed Meat Stew...? That's not relevant right now, so why are you suddenly bringing this up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this might just be Paimon feeling hungry after all this running about, but now that Bona's found the Tonatiuh and gotten her hands on the Jade of Return, her wish has been fulfilled, right?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Something's not right... I'm sure I've been here before, the Tonatiuh, and the Jade of Return...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Yes, we must destroy it... It cannot fall into the hands of that person...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you okay, Bona?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Bona? No... Bona should be long gone. Why am I still here...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #I see, so that's what's— Careful, {NICKNAME}! Don't come any closer. This is a trap...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: So, we found one, and that's a great start! First step's always the hardest, as they say. Things should go more smoothly from here on out!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll be counting on you to find those Firestones. Just holler if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Not bad! That's half of them. Let's keep it up!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll be counting on you to find those Firestones. Just holler if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Now, all we've gotta do is make that offering, and...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Ugh, who knew we'd be looking all over for stones after finally making it to the Tonatiuh? I thought this would be a more thrilling adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll be counting on you to find those Firestones. Just holler if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Just one more to go now. The finish line is just around the corner!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'll be counting on you to find that last Firestone. Just holler if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Eh? Where did the little Tepetlisaurus who's with you go?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Don't leave your companions behind, alright?
